business_summary: Yuzhou Group Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development and investment business in China and Hong Kong. The company operates through Property Development, Property Investment, Property Management, Hotel Operation, and Other segments. It develops, sells, invests in, and manages properties, as well as operates hotels. The company was formerly known as Yuzhou Properties Company Limited and changed its name to Yuzhou Group Holdings Company Limited in June 2020. Yuzhou Group Holdings Company Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Central, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Yuzhou Group Holdings Company Limited는 중국과 홍콩에서 부동산 개발 및 투자 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 부동산 개발, 부동산 투자, 부동산 관리, 호텔 운영 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 부동산을 개발, 판매, 투자, 관리하고 호텔을 운영합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Yuzhou Properties Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2020년 6월에 Yuzhou Group Holdings Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Yuzhou Group Holdings Company Limited는 1994년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
